scope: The np mod: a desktop SessionMode hook drawing the footer's np entry as a Select (summary closed; Open NativePeers and each worker's conversation open) in place of the one-line band, its ui.close tracking and activation reconcile, and $.ui.status on the desktop app; native worker buttons with a footnote status line; a conversation headline in one footnote line (with the model asked for when another answered); labelled turns; tool steps as one line with shell wrappers stripped; file changes and generation ends as notes; follow-ups without the trailing contract; on the desktop app long messages folded behind Show more and tool output opened on press; scroll to the end on open, on new rows and on send; space below the field; a one-second redraw while a worker runs and the pane is shown; no toast on send. The desktop app run needs the person after install.

finding.observed: Desktop check after PR #46 (engine 2.1.309), 2026-10-31. The band above the prompt offered a closed pane back where the footer's np entry was wanted as a menu. Worker buttons in the list had no button face and no room above or below. The back arrow (‹) was small. The field was visible only after scrolling to the end, and was cut off at its bottom edge. A running worker's time stayed at 0s, then jumped to 12s when it ended. The pane did not follow new rows. Rows showed shell wrappers and raw text. Each send raised a large toast.
finding.cause: The list drew its worker buttons plain, without spacing. Elapsed time is computed when the pane draws, and nothing redrew it while a worker ran without lineage changes. The pane never called $.ui.scroll, and the field had no space below it. deliverDraft toasted every outcome. Rows used the tool title as the provider reported it (/bin/zsh -lc '…'), and a follow-up's input_preview carries NativePeers' contract after the message.
finding.found_while_fixing: The terminal keeps a pane's focus ring by position: with a toggle button drawn among the rows, the ring that autoFocus put on the field (debug log: ui.focus onto np's say-0: moved) landed on the button when the rows arrived above it, and typed text reached the main prompt. Rows stay text on the terminal; the toggles are drawn on the desktop app only.
